account_password_note: Your other sign-ins end; this one stays.
ask_check_bad: Check the sources: {unknown} unknown reference(s), {uncited} paragraph(s) without a source.
ask_intro: Ask a question: get the matching passages (to hand to any AI), or an answer written from them with every claim checked.
ask_no_hits: Nothing in the knowledge base matches this question.
ask_placeholder: What do you want to know?
cat_access_open: Open category: every project member gets the level of their role; a grant can only raise it.
cat_access_restricted: Restricted category: only the owner, project admins and people or groups given a grant here can see it.
cat_access_tip: To limit who sees it, edit the category and make it restricted.
cat_create_first: Optional: playbooks run without any knowledge (on data from a connector). Add a category when you want documents to ask about.
cat_no_group_grants: No group has a grant here.
cat_open_title: Open this category to every member?
cat_restricted_hint: Only members granted access see a restricted category.
categories_intro: Knowledge is kept in categories; decide who can use each one.
conn_intro: Pull data from other systems into datasets, on request or on a schedule.
conn_secret_hint: Store the token as a project secret (Secrets tab) under the name used in the spec.
copy_categories_hint: A short name already used there gets a number added.
copy_intro: Each project keeps its own knowledge and playbooks: this makes a copy in the other project (documents with their search index; access grants stay here).
copy_playbooks: Also copy which playbooks are on (and their settings)
dash_intro: What the workspace holds and what ran, where and how often: playbook runs, documents, datasets and events.
dash_no_data: No calls in this period yet.
data_intro: Tables the playbooks read; every upload or sync keeps a new version.
data_name_hint: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _. Uploading to an existing name adds a new version.
docs_empty: No documents in this category yet.
docs_remove_text: Its passages leave the knowledge base at once.
docs_upload_hint: TXT, Markdown, CSV, PDF or Word. It is searchable once indexed (a few seconds to minutes).
docs_uploaded: Uploaded. Indexing runs in the background.
err_answer_llm_failed: The answer model did not respond. Try again later.
err_answer_llm_unavailable: The answer model is not set up for this project.
err_answer_question_not_found: That question is not in your log any more.
err_apikey_bad_public_key: The public key must be an Ed25519 key in PEM format.
err_apikey_invalid: Choose at least one scope and a lifetime within the limit.
err_apikey_revoked: This key was revoked; issue a new one instead.
err_auth_csrf: The request was refused for safety. Reload the page and try again.
err_auth_key_invalid: This API key is unknown, revoked, expired or disabled.
err_auth_not_a_session: API keys revoke their tokens instead of signing out.
err_auth_password_short: Password is too short (at least {min} characters).
err_auth_password_weak: The password needs a lowercase letter, an uppercase letter and a digit.
err_auth_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Try again in {retry_after} seconds.
err_auth_refresh_reused: A used refresh token was presented again; all its tokens were revoked.
err_auth_replay: This signed request was already used.
err_auth_scope: This API key does not allow this action.
err_auth_signature_invalid: The request signature is not valid.
err_auth_superadmin_only: Only a superadmin can do this.
err_auth_token_invalid: The token is invalid, expired or revoked.
err_category_forbidden: You do not have enough access to this category.
err_category_slug_taken: This project already has a category with that short name.
err_connector_too_often: The schedule is too frequent (minimum {min} minutes).
err_copy_same_project: Pick another project to copy into.
err_dataset_empty: The dataset has no data yet.
err_dataset_too_large: The dataset file is too large.
err_dataset_unreadable: The dataset file could not be read.
err_document_empty: No text could be read from the file.
err_document_unsupported: This file type is not supported.
err_eval_too_many_cases: Too many cases in one run (max {max}).
err_event_bad_url: This address cannot be called (https and a public address are required).
err_event_delivery_not_found: Delivery not found (or not finished yet).
err_group_name_taken: A group already has this name.
err_insights_not_found: Not found, or not yours to see.
err_member_is_owner: The owner already has every right.
err_playbook_bad_locale: Pick a language other than English (two letters).
err_playbook_bad_scope: Overrides apply to the whole system or to one project.
err_playbook_disabled: This playbook is switched off in this project.
err_playbook_not_runnable: This playbook version is paused or retired.
err_playbook_param_invalid: A parameter value is out of range or of the wrong type.
err_playbook_version_exists: This version exists already; add a new version instead.
err_project_forbidden: You are not allowed to do this in this project.
err_project_owner_only: Only the owner can delete a project.
err_project_slug_taken: You already have a project with this short name.
err_recall_query_too_long: The search is too long (max {max} characters).
err_run_forbidden: Your role cannot start runs in this project.
err_secret_bad_value: The value is empty or too long.
err_setting_invalid: This value does not fit the setting.
err_setting_scope: This setting cannot be changed here.
err_synapse_bad_source: This folder cannot be a source (outside the allowed folders or not a git repository).
err_synapse_bad_target: The category is not in that project.
err_user_bad_avatar: Pick a picture from the list.
err_user_bad_name: The name is empty or too long.
err_user_not_found: No active user with this email.
err_user_self_change: Change your own role or status from another account.
ev_intro: Receivers get every matching event as signed CloudEvents JSON (Standard Webhooks headers). Each one has its own queue: a slow or failing receiver never delays another.
ev_off_text: Nothing is delivered until it is switched on again.
ev_on_text: New events are delivered to it again.
ev_remove_text: Its queue and delivery history go with it.
ev_replay_text: The receiver gets the same event once more.
ev_secret_note: Shown once: store it now in the receiver. It signs every delivery.
ev_system_intro: Receivers here get events from every project.
eval_intro: A golden set is a list of questions with the passages they should find (title or "title#section"); an empty list means off-topic: the right answer is nothing. Retrieval scores are computed without any LLM and every run is kept, with the model and cutoffs that produced it. An LLM judge can also grade whether the passages answer each question and whether the project's answers stick to them (use a stronger model than the one answering).
groups_delete_text: Its members lose every right the group gave them (their own rights stay).
groups_intro: Give a project or a category to a whole group at once: everyone in it, also people added later, gets the same rights. A person's own role still wins.
groups_member_remove_text: They lose what “{group}” gives them, at once.
groups_members_hint: Everyone here gets the group's rights in every project that has the group.
groups_of_user_hint: They get the rights of every group ticked.
key_shown_once: Key {key} issued. Copy the private key now: it is shown only once and the server keeps no copy.
keys_explain: Keys let scripts, the CLI and other systems call the API. Each request is signed with the key's private part (never sent) and expires within minutes; access tokens are short-lived and can be revoked.
keys_revoke_text: Anything using this key stops working at once. This cannot be undone.
keys_rotate_text: A new key pair is made with the same owner, scopes and projects. The current key stops working at once: put the new private key wherever the old one was used.
keys_rotated: New key made: copy it now
knowledge_intro: Documents by category, as a network of what is asked together or as a table.
logs_intro: Who changed what, and when (sign-ins, members, documents, settings, keys).
mega_admin_desc: People, keys, integrations and the system.
mega_cta_admin: Give someone access or a key for another system.
mega_cta_projects: Start a new knowledge space for a team or a topic.
mega_cta_workspace: See every run and question, who asked and what came back.
mega_workspace_desc: Your work: dashboards, projects and results.
mem_drop_own_text: They keep what their groups give them here.
mem_group_hint: Everyone in the group gets this role here, also people who join it later.
mem_group_remove_text: Its members lose the role it gave them here (their own roles stay).
mem_groups_empty: No group has a role here.
mem_invite_hint: The person must already have an account.
mem_people_hint: Everyone with a role here and where it comes from; set someone's own role to override their groups.
mem_remove_text: They lose access to everything in this project.
nav_desc_api_keys: Signed keys for scripts and systems
nav_desc_dashboard: Charts of what was called and how often
nav_desc_groups: People in groups, rights for all of them
nav_desc_playbooks: Ready-made analyses and where they run
nav_desc_projects: Knowledge, data and playbooks per project
nav_desc_results: Every run and question with its answer
net_empty: No documents yet: upload one to grow the network.
net_hint: Hover a node to light up its links; click a document to read it.
pb_add_hint: A project starts with no playbook: tick the ones this project may run.
pb_assign_all_hint: On for every project, except one that switched it off itself.
pb_custom_spec: Custom playbook spec (JSON, see the playbook guide)
pb_how_text: Pick a playbook, give it its inputs (a dataset or a table) and adjust its parameters; each run is kept with who ran it, its inputs and its outputs. Versions move from provisional to active once measured.
pb_off_text_system: No project can run it until it is switched on again (a project's own choice still wins).
pb_on_text_system: Every project can run it again (a project's own choice still wins).
pb_page_intro: Ready-made analyses that run the same way every time, on your data, with the numbers computed by code (never guessed by an AI).
pb_project_empty: No playbook is on for this project yet. Assign one on the Playbooks page.
pb_remove_text: It can no longer run here; earlier runs stay.
pb_translate_hint: English is the base text. Leave both fields empty to go back to the shipped translation.
pb_use_text: Screens and rankings you want to repeat exactly, shared by people, scripts, MCP clients and other systems through the same API.
pb_what_text: A recipe: a fixed list of steps, each calling one function (filter a table, compute values, rank, screen) on the data you give it.
project_delete_text: Every document, dataset, run and setting of this project goes with it. This cannot be undone.
project_settings_intro: Choices for this project (they win over the system's).
projects_empty: No projects yet. Create one below.
projects_intro: Each project holds its own knowledge, data, playbooks and members.
res_check_bad: Citations to review: {unknown} unknown, {uncited} without a source
res_intro: Every playbook run and every question to the knowledge: who called it, when, through which channel, what it used and what came of it.
res_no_answer: No answer was kept for this question (the caller wrote it elsewhere and did not report it, or used the passages only).
runs_intro: Every run of this project; click one to see its inputs, steps and outputs.
sec_remove_text: Connectors or models using it stop working until it is set again.
secrets_intro: Tokens and keys this project uses; stored encrypted, never shown again.
secrets_write_only: Secrets are write-only: after saving, only a short hint is shown — never the value.
settings_intro_mine: Your own preferences. They follow your account to every device.
settings_intro_system: Defaults for every project and user. A project's or user's own choice still wins.
signin_intro: Your knowledge, playbooks and results in one place.
signin_point_1: Answers that cite their sources, checked line by line
signin_point_2: Analyses computed by code, repeatable run after run
signin_point_3: Signed API keys and per-project permissions
signin_slow: The server is taking longer than usual. Still signing you in…
signout_text: You will need your email and password to come back.
syn_accept_text: “{path}” goes into the knowledge base (or the task list).
syn_check_text: New commits since the last check become a proposal to review.
syn_intro: A source is a repository read in read-only mode. New commits become a proposal: personal data removed, numbers marked for re-measurement, knowledge accepted item by item; code changes become tasks, never automatic edits.
syn_reject_text: “{path}” is left out; the decision is kept.
theme_saved_note: Your choice is saved with your account.
ui_bad_json: A JSON field is not valid JSON.
users_disable_text: They are signed out everywhere and cannot sign in until enabled again.
users_enable_text: They can sign in again with their password.
users_intro: Accounts that can sign in. A superadmin sees every project; others see the projects they are members of.
users_reset_note: Every sign-in of this account ends. Tell them the new password in a safe way.
